question: Alignment of chromosomes in the center of the cell at the equatorial plate constitutes which stage of mitosis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Metaphase.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Mitosis is a kind of** cell division** in which** one cell **(the mother) divides to generate **two genetically identical new cells **(the daughters).
 
• Mitosis is the stage of the cell cycle's division process in which the** DNA **of the cell's nucleus is **split** into two equal sets of chromosomes.
 
• Mitotic divisions are a mode of reproduction </s
